<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>MasUnity.HealthCheck</id>
    <version>1.0.5-beta</version>
    <title>MasUnity is a .net multi-agent system framework</title>
    <authors>Yan Justino</authors>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <icon>logo.png</icon>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/8T4/mas-unity</projectUrl>
    <description>MasUnity is a .net framework based on MAS (multi-agent system framework) concepts for applying agents to solve IBIS-related problems (integrative business information systems), in an industry context.</description>
    <tags>MAS, MIBS, IBIS, DAI</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/8T4/mas-unity" commit="2dda2511656812f0ae6cdc45456eb52f62e6b061" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETCoreApp3.1">
        <dependency id="MasUnity.HostedService" version="1.0.5-beta" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MasUnity" version="1.0.5-beta" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks" version="3.1.16" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net5.0">
        <dependency id="MasUnity.HostedService" version="1.0.5-beta" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MasUnity" version="1.0.5-beta" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks" version="5.0.7" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
